fusions.name: Mycelial Bind
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Caged] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Puffball Burst
fusions.desc: Bursts a cloud that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each hit has a 15% chance to leave the target [Caged] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Brittle Husk
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and each such blow leaves the attacker [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Colony
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You regenerate 0.5 health a second and your armour rises by 5%.
